transcript: Tonight I saw the first preview of Bob fosse's Dance in a musical with pretty much no plot but some singing and plenty of dancing. Obviously shows performed by company of 16, and they are working. Some numbers are solos or small groups, but overall everyone is really involved and basically never off stage for more than a few minutes at a time. I know nothing about dance, but I was really impressed, and I think the show does a fantastic job of engaging the audience the entire time. The choreography and the staging is super dynamic, and you get a chance to really get acquainted with each and every performance. Also, the numbers are sequenced and cast in a way that everyone has a chance to show their personality throughout the show, which I really enjoyed. With that, another playbill for my collection.
